description: Fork-specific action provenance registry. Cherri action definitions remain the sole source of truth for parameters, plist keys, types, enums, defaults, and semantics. This registry answers exactly one question: did this behavior originate in upstream Cherri, or was it added or materially changed by this fork?

upstream.baselineSubject: Remove unnecessary identifier from file() action
upstream.baselineDetermination: merge-base(HEAD, upstream/main) when this registry was created; the fork branch contains the full upstream history, so every fork change is a descendant of this SHA.
upstream.note: Re-record a fresh baseline (new merge-base) whenever upstream is synced; never rewrite existing entries.

changeType.added-by-fork: The action does not exist in upstream Cherri at the recorded baseline; this fork introduced it.
changeType.modified-by-fork: The action exists at the recorded baseline; this fork extended or corrected its parameters, serialization, compiler handling, or decompiler handling.

upstreamStatus.absent-upstream: No such action in upstream at baseline.
upstreamStatus.present-upstream-extended: Present upstream; fork added capability without changing existing behavior.
upstreamStatus.present-upstream-corrected: Present upstream; fork changed existing behavior to fix incorrect output.

conventions.noEntryMeans: Inherited from upstream and untouched by this fork. Do not create entries for unchanged actions.
conventions.supersededByUpstream: Set to the upstream SHA/subject that later provided equivalent functionality natively. Keep the entry and append to history instead of deleting it, then decide whether to drop, keep, or reconcile the fork implementation.
conventions.firstForkCommit: The fork commit that introduced the change. Recorded once the change is committed.

recovery.restoreUpstreamBehavior: git show <baselineSha>:<upstreamLocation> > <forkLocation> (then re-run tests); prefer re-implementing over blind restore when later fork changes depend on it.

seededFrom: batch-001 corpus analysis (analysis/batch-001). Historical audit against baseline 951c0bb found no pre-existing fork-specific action changes; all earlier fork divergence was iOS app, skill, CI, docs, tooling, and the action catalog generator itself.

actions.name: runJavaScriptOnWebpage
actions.change: Added optional input parameter (&variable ?input: 'WFInput') so compiled actions can carry the webpage-content input real Shortcuts serialize.
actions.reason: Every observed real-world sample carried WFInput; upstream definition emitted WFJavaScript only.
actions.evidence: corpus batch-001: OBSERVED x4 (4 independent shapes), analysis/batch-001/variants.json (pre-fix)

actions.name: saveFile
actions.change: Added optional folder reference parameter (&variable ?folder: 'WFFolder') alongside the legacy path-based destination.
actions.reason: Modern Shortcuts serialize Save File with WFFolder {displayName,fileLocation,filename} next to WFFileDestinationPath and WFAskWhereToSave; legacy path behavior preserved.
actions.evidence: corpus batch-001: OBSERVED x3 shapes carrying WFFolder + WFAskWhereToSave
notes: Observed WFFolder payload is an Apple-side picker structure; Cherri emits a variable reference attachment instead. Structural equivalence unverified on-device.

actions.name: openApp
actions.change: Added optional slideOver bool parameter (WFOpenInSlideOver) and matching custom-decompiler argument emission; made replaceAppIDs skip non-string arguments so boolean parameters coexist with app ID replacement.
actions.reason: Real samples carry WFOpenInSlideOver:true (x2) and fuller WFSelectedApp dicts; slide-over was unrepresentable.
actions.evidence: corpus batch-001: OBSERVED x6 shapes; WFOpenInSlideOver x2; round-trip verified via tests/corpus-batch001.cherri
notes: WFSelectedApp Name/TeamIdentifier enrichment intentionally NOT implemented: no local source for those values; inventing them would violate evidence rules.
replaceAppIDs hardening is required collateral of the new parameter type.

actions.name: run
actions.change: Moved run() from declarative DSL (actions/shortcuts.cherri, definition removed) to a builtin in actions_std.go so compilation emits the modern WFWorkflow reference dict {workflowIdentifier,isSelf:false,workflowName} together with the legacy WFWorkflowName key, mirroring the existing runSelf pattern; added decompiler support emitting both arguments.
actions.reason: Real Shortcuts carry the dict form next to the legacy name key; improves emitted fidelity and structural round-trip while preserving the one-line UX.
actions.evidence: corpus batch-001: OBSERVED x3 shapes containing WFWorkflow dict; verified round-trip via tests/shortcuts.cherri
notes: workflowIdentifier is a generated placeholder UUID because name-to-UUID resolution requires device data; Shortcuts resolves through workflowName. This derivation is INFERRED from existing runSelf behavior, not confirmed on-device.

infrastructure.name: action catalog completeness
infrastructure.change: Catalog v2: publishes emittedKeys (static appendParams keys plus dynamically written keys declared per builtin) and compilerConstruct entries (conditional, menu, repeat, repeat.each, setVariable, appendVariable, dictionaryValue) so --actions-json represents everything the compiler can emit.
infrastructure.reason: Analyzer and downstream consumers compared observed Shortcut shapes against incomplete key sets, misclassifying most control-flow and builtin emissions as VARIANT/NEW.
infrastructure.evidence: batch-001 analysis: VARIANT shapes 57 -> 9, occurrences 116 -> 10 after this change; zero regressions.
infrastructure.note: Metadata/tooling work, not a new Shortcut action.

infrastructure.name: corpus analyzer App Intent detection
infrastructure.change: requiresCustomImplementation now treats AppIntentDescriptor as a complex parameter key and detects plain nested descriptor dictionaries lacking WFSerializationType markers.
infrastructure.reason: App Intent-backed actions (e.g. is.workflow.actions.filter.notes) were misclassified SAFE_CANDIDATE instead of CUSTOM_IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRED.
infrastructure.evidence: batch-001: filter.notes reclassified correctly; unit test TestNestedPlainAppIntentDescriptorRequiresCustomImplementation.
infrastructure.note: Tooling provenance, not an action addition.
